The '''Nothoiin system''' was a [[Star system/Legends|star system]] located in the [[Anoat sector/Legends|Anoat sector]] of the [[Outer Rim Territories/Legends|Outer Rim Territories]].<ref name="TEAOC" /> It contained the [[Planet/Legends|planet]] [[Nothoiin/Legends|Nothoiin]], the [[Homeworld/Legends|homeworld]] of the [[Nothoiin (species)/Legends|Nothoiins]]. Nothoiin was orbited by a crystalline [[Moon/Legends|moon]] which was mined for its [[Ur-diamond/Legends|ur-diamonds]], the system's main export.<ref name="GG" />
